title: What building an AI-native finance function taught me
summary: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar shares five lessons for building an AI-native finance function, from automated forecasting to stronger controls and AI ROI.
body: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar shares five lessons for building an AI-native finance function, from automated forecasting to stronger controls and AI ROI.
summaryZh: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar 分享了构建AI原生财务职能的五大核心经验，内容涵盖从自动化财务预测到建立更强的内部控制机制以及评估AI投资回报率（ROI），为企业落地AI提供了具体的业务管理参考。
